mutants.description: In S_SS ramp completion outranks the overcurrent window trip: window_trip_SS is only honoured while SS_done is low
mutants.reason: When fault_arbiter raises window_trip_SS on the same clock that soft_start raises SS_done, the FSM goes to S_RUN instead of S_HICCUP, so run_active rises and hiccup_active stays low, en stays high, and the cool-down is skipped.

before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
after: if ((~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) & ~window_trip_SS) begin
mutants.description: In S_SS an overcurrent window trip outranks a hard fault, so a coincident shutdown is first sent through S_HICCUP
mutants.reason: If a hard fault (OTP, UVLO, latch, latch_assert or loss of enable) arrives on the same clock as window_trip_SS in S_SS, the FSM enters S_HICCUP instead of S_OFF. hiccup_active and state_out show S_HICCUP for a clock, and strike_counter counts a strike.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
after: if ((~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) & ~window_trip) begin
mutants.description: In S_RUN the overcurrent window trip outranks a hard fault, so a coincident shutdown goes to S_HICCUP first
mutants.reason: When a hard fault and window_trip are both high in S_RUN, the FSM enters S_HICCUP instead of S_OFF. hiccup_active and state_out show the cool-down state for at least one clock, and a strike is counted for what should have been a shutdown.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
after: if ((~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) & ~hiccup_done) begin
mutants.description: In S_HICCUP the end of the cool-down outranks a hard fault, so a retry into S_SS wins over a shutdown
mutants.reason: If a hard fault is present on the clock where hiccup_done rises, the FSM retries into S_SS instead of going to S_OFF, so ss_active and state_out show S_SS. If the fault was a one-clock latch_assert pulse, en rises again before latch_state is read back.

before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
after: if ((~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) & ~SS_done) begin
mutants.description: In S_SS ramp completion outranks the hard faults, so a fault at the end of the ramp still promotes the FSM to S_RUN
mutants.reason: A hard fault on the clock where SS_done rises sends the FSM to S_RUN instead of S_OFF, so run_active pulses high. If the fault was a one-clock latch_assert, the FSM stays in S_RUN and en comes back at full duty.

mutants.description: The combinational en gating uses the physical switch alone, so a host disable over SPI waits for the FSM to reach S_OFF
mutants.reason: When spi_enable falls in S_SS or S_RUN with en_SW still high, en stays high for one more clock until state registers S_OFF, instead of dropping on the same clock.

mutants.description: hiccup_active is dropped as soon as the cool-down reports done, a clock before the FSM leaves S_HICCUP
mutants.reason: On the last clock of S_HICCUP, when hiccup_done is high, the hiccup_active port goes low while state_out still shows S_HICCUP. hiccup_timer then clears its counter and hiccup_done one clock earlier than it should.

mutants.description: Start-up from S_OFF checks only the physical switch and forgets the host enable over SPI
mutants.reason: With en_SW high and spi_enable low, the FSM leaves S_OFF for S_SS, and the S_SS hard-fault check sends it straight back. ss_active and state_out then toggle every clock while the host has the converter disabled.
